chronologyRules: The Spiritual Realm has no reliable shared clock; remembered scenes and visions must be tagged separately from their present-day discovery.
Gavinor’s subjective years cannot be plotted as elapsed Rosharan calendar years.
After Retribution, Rosharan time and offworld time diverge; avoid applying a single exact conversion to all scenes.
Book/day or chapter sequence is not evidence for exact simultaneity across fronts.
Ancient round-number dates are in-book relative estimates, not independently calibrated calendar dates.

qualityNotes: Full published Stormlight scope must include the two Lost Tales first released in 2024 Story Decks and subsequently in print/ebook.
Wind and Truth ends the first five-book arc; the series itself is unfinished.
Shallan’s pregnancy is a strong textual implication and must remain labeled as such.
The Blackthorn recruited by Retribution is a Spiritual remnant, not evidence that the deceased Dalinar’s whole soul serves him.
Mishram’s release and recovering deadeyes are related in the ending; avoid claiming all deadeyes instantly recovered completely.
No copied fan art or map files were collected. Official map links can be offered with attribution; schematic coordinates must be labeled approximate.
Some community pages could only be read through indexed search text because direct requests returned 403. Publisher-hosted rereads were directly opened.

magicUpdates.summary: Retribution withdraws Stormlight; existing Radiant bonds do not provide a replacement fuel supply.
Towerlight remains available inside protected Urithiru.
The loss of Stormlight disables Oathgate travel.
The renewed pact protects spren against Retribution, with Kaladin filling Jezrien’s place.
Having learned from Honorblades, Nightblood can grant its wielder access to the Surges.
Hoid transfers the Exist Dawnshard to Sigzil.
Unoathed weapons and armor function without the ordinary Stormlight requirement.
Honor and Odium are held together by Taravangian as Retribution.

itemUpdates.name: Kaladin’s Honorspear
itemUpdates.summary: A new divine spear forms as Kaladin joins the Heralds; it is distinct from Syl’s weapon form.
Armor chooses Adolin and reshapes to support his missing lower leg.
Grants Surgebinding learned from the Honorblades and exercises a choice not to consume Szeth.
Gavinor carries Oathbringer as Odium’s champion and retains it after the contest.

factionUpdates.summary: Adolin’s deadeye-associated Shardbearers form an ongoing force in Azimir.
A signed treaty recognizes listener ownership of the Shattered Plains.

Iyatil and Mraize die; the wider organization continues.
